name: Camp Nou
description: Europe's largest stadium and the beating heart of FC Barcelona. Currently undergoing renovation ("Espai Barça"), Camp Nou remains a must-visit for any football fan in Barcelona.

howToGetThere.publicTransport: Metro line L9 South or L10 South, Camp Nou station. Alternative: line L3, Palau Reial station, then a 10-minute walk. Buses H6, 54 and D20 also serve the stadium.
howToGetThere.fromAirport: Direct L9 South metro line from the airport to Camp Nou station, about 35 minutes with no transfer.

bestTimeToVisit: Go on a weekday morning outside school holidays to avoid crowds. Late afternoon light is ideal for photos of the stadium exterior.

insiderTip: Book your time slot online to skip the queue, and arrive right at opening on weekdays: some parts of the tour route are temporarily altered during the Espai Barça works.
